title: Mask secrets in a log line
hints: re.sub accepts a function as the replacement; it is called with each Match and returns the text to put in its place.
Capture the part to keep and the value separately: r"((?:password|token)\s*[=:]\s*)([^\s;,&]+)" with re.IGNORECASE. The replacement returns m.group(1) + masked_value.
Masking is a slice: '*' * (len(v) - 4) + v[-4:] when len(v) > 4, otherwise '*' * len(v).
Handle Bearer with a second pattern r"(Bearer )([A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+)" (or one alternation) and reuse the same replacement function.
